id: title:dmarchuk:show a batch run s own log on the run it belongs to

review.posthog_relevance: Allows HogFlow batch invocations and BatchRunLog to use the same viewer without URL state bleeding between unrelated batch runs.
review.reason: Adds an optional prop `disableUrlSync` and associated checks to the LogsViewer, allowing HogFlow batch invocations and BatchRunLog to opt out of shared URL parameters. P1.F2.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F2.H3.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of HogFlow batch invocations and BatchRunLog, which are not demonstrated in this chunk; the score is assigned based on the explicit connection stated in the observations, not independently verified. No tier 3 systemic risk or tier 2 substantive capability is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional prop `disableUrlSync` to the LogsViewer, allowing a viewer to opt out of shared URL parameters. P1.F2.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Allows HogFlow batch invocations and BatchRunLog to use the same viewer without URL state bleeding between unrelated batch runs.

observations.behavior: Checks the new prop and returns an empty object, skipping URL parameter synchronization. P1.F2.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents batch-specific invocations from writing shared URL parameters, preserving the state of other viewers.

observations.behavior: Checks the new prop and returns early, skipping URL parameter deserialization. P1.F2.H3
